status_summary: No enacted law, bill or federal contracting rule imposing a citizenship share on contractor workforces was found. H.R. 9063, the Hire American Act, introduced 2026-05-29, would amend Title 5 to require that federal employees be U.S. citizens or nationals, with limited exceptions; per its GovInfo listing and trade press, it covers federal employment, not contractor workforces, and it is not counted as this recommendation. No bill amending the law to let private employers prefer citizens in hiring was found.
title: Require 70 percent U.S. citizens among workers on new federal contracts
uncertainties: No enacted law, bill or federal contracting rule imposing a citizenship share on contractor workforces was found, and no bill letting private employers prefer citizens in hiring. The Labor and FAR Council Unified Agenda rule lists on reginfo.gov (Agency Rule List - 2026) carry no such entry; the FAR overhaul cases list part numbers only and were not opened. H.R. 9063 concerns federal employees, not contractors, and its text was not read. Bill searches were read by title, congress.gov could not be fetched, and the GSA and DOL newsrooms were not checked, so a bill the searches missed cannot be excluded.
